_help: Windows version — see archive-list.linux-macos.json for Linux/macOS. Lists an archive's contents as text in Quick Look ("outputExt": "txt"), using 7-Zip's command-line 7z.exe. The grid keeps the plain file icon, since text output has no thumbnail. Preview generator config — see docs/generators.md for the full guide. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_" when loading.
_help_extensions: Lowercase extensions (no dot). A .tar.gz shows as one inner .tar here (7z lists one layer at a time); the Linux/macOS bsdtar version lists the tar's members directly.
_help_cmd: 7z on PATH (scoop install 7zip puts it there). The regular 7-Zip installer doesn't add it to PATH — use "C:\\Program Files\\7-Zip\\7z.exe" then.
_help_args: 7z l prints the listing to stdout ("stdout": true saves it as the output). -sccUTF-8 makes it print UTF-8 instead of the console code page, so non-ASCII names survive. -p with an empty password stops 7z from waiting for one: an archive with encrypted file names then fails fast and Quick Look shows no preview, while one with only encrypted contents still lists normally.
